#define rep(i, l, r) for(int i = l; i <= r; i++)
#define repd(i, r, l) for(int i = r; i >= l; i--)
#define each(i, n) for(auto i = 0; i < n; i++)
#define all(x) (x).begin(), (x).end()
#define sz(x) (int)(x).size()
#define pb push_back
#define eb emplace_back
#define mp make_pair
#define mt make_tuple
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define ld long double
#define ll long long
#define ull unsigned long long
#define endl "\n"
#define fastio ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0)

using namespace std;

const ld pi = 3.141592654;
const ll N = 1000500;
const ll mod = 1000000007;

mt19937 rng(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());

ll repe[N];
ll used[N];
ll mult[N];

ll doit(ll i, ll k, ll n){
	ll cant = 0;

	while(1){
		if(used[i]) break;
		used[i] = true;
		i = (i * k) % n;
		cant++;
	}

	return cant;
}

ll bipow(ll a, ll b){
	if(b == 0) return 1;

	ll ans = bipow(a, b / 2);

	if(b % 2 == 0) return (ans * ans) % mod;
	else return (a * ((ans * ans) % mod)) % mod;
}

int main(){
	fastio;
	ll n, k;
	cin >> n >> k;

	if(k == 0){
		cout << bipow(n, n - 1) << endl;
		return 0;
	}

	for(ll i = 0; i < n; i++){
		if(!used[i]) {
			ll w = doit(i, k, n);
			repe[w]++;
		}
	}

	for(ll i = 1; i <= n; i++){
		for(ll j = i; j <= n; j += i){
			if(repe[j] != 0) mult[j] += repe[i] * i;
		}
	}

	ll ans = 1;
	for(ll i = 1; i <= n; i++){

		if(mult[i] != 0) ans = (ans * bipow(mult[i], repe[i])) % mod;
	}

	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}
